items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the main highlight was the UK CPI report. Headline CPI came in line with expectations at 3.6% y/y, while core inflation remained unchanged at 2.8% and services inflation missed forecasts matching last month's 3.7% figure.
